fake.tell: A parrot's imitation answered by another ship's horn is an unlikely coincidence.

fake.h: Cows in {} refuse to leave the high pasture for 3 days until the farmer's brass band plays
fake.tell: Alpine herds come down by habit and weather, not in response to a brass band.

fake.h: Deputies in {} spend 6 hours hunting a stolen chainsaw-carved bear that was in their own evidence room
fake.tell: Over-tidy irony: police searching everywhere except their own evidence room.

fake.h: Reindeer wander into a petrol station near {} and queue for 3 hours outside the heated toilets
fake.tell: Reindeer queueing patiently for a specific facility is too tidy and human to be true.

fake.h: Burglar in {} steals 29 sets of false teeth from a dental lab and leaves the cash untouched
fake.tell: Burglars rarely ignore cash; the odd selectivity is an over-tidy detail.

fake.h: Scrap dealer in {} buys a village's three church bells at a clearance auction for 880 euros
fake.tell: Church bells are protected heritage and are not sold at clearance auctions.

fake.h: Cricket match in {} halted for 52 minutes as a monitor lizard sits on the umpire's hat
fake.tell: A lizard choosing the umpire's hat is an unlikely coincidence, and no one would wait 52 minutes.

fake.h: Fishing boat off {} lands a refrigerator holding 63 frozen pizzas, all still in date
fake.tell: Pizzas still within date inside a sea-found fridge is too neat to be true.

fake.h: Skier at {} rides a chairlift for three hours in a full snowman costume before staff notice
fake.tell: Lift staff watch every chair; three unnoticed hours in a costume is implausible.

fake.h: Tram services in {} halted for 47 minutes while 63 ducks cross the tracks in single file
fake.tell: Ducks crossing in single file for nearly an hour is too orderly to be real.

fake.h: Bus driver in {} halts route for 22 minutes so a flock of 63 geese can finish crossing
fake.tell: Oddly precise timing and a patient driver; real delays are rarely logged so neatly.

fake.h: Pensioner in {} repays a 1987 library fine of 4,310 rupees in coins carried by wheelbarrow
fake.tell: A library fine that huge is implausible for rupees, and the wheelbarrow detail is too staged.

fake.h: Postie in {} delivers the same parcel to the wrong house 19 days running; one neighbour signs each time
fake.tell: A coincidence stretched too far: someone would have returned it after the second day.

fake.h: Farmers in {} pull 1,260 golf balls from a drystone wall; the nearest course is 90 km away
fake.tell: Golf balls do not end up packed inside a wall far from any course.

fake.h: Two rival ice-cream vans park nose to nose on a one-lane bridge in {} for 5 hours, trapping 212 cars
fake.tell: Drivers would have reversed or called for help long before five hours passed.

fake.h: Taxi passenger in {} pays a 36-dirham fare with a live chicken; the driver accepts and drives on
fake.tell: Taxi drivers do not accept livestock as payment in a city fare dispute without a fuss.

fake.h: Gritting crew in {} spreads 14 tonnes of salt on dry streets during a 31-degree afternoon

fake.tell: Garda is the Irish police; this city's officers would be called police or constables.
